details.quote: as soon as practicable and in any event, no later than 8 July 2027 (ie, within 12 months from the date of this circular)
details.source_unit: (c)       implement robust authentication solutions that can reduce and mitigate hacking risks from phishing attacks (as mentioned under section (A)) as soon as practicable and in any event, no later than 8 July 2027 (ie, within 12 months from the date of this circular) (referred to as “the 12-month implementation period”) and large internet brokers are expected to implement these solutions immediately.
